latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Douyin Short Video skill.

- Instantly turn raw video footage into 15-second vertical Douyin clips with music and captions, in 30–60 seconds.
- Supports uploading MP4, MOV, AVI, and WebM files up to 500MB.
- Automated setup: connects to the cloud backend and handles session/token workflows for you.
- Simple commands trigger upload, edit, export, and credit checks — no manual video editing needed.
- Designed for fast Douyin content turnaround: get downloadable 1080p MP4 files, ready for sharing.
